title: Courts And Justice Administration In Nigeria
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an affirmation that the police representing the state is satisfied that the suspect is guilty of an offence with which he is changed."
The arraignment is an affirmation that the police representing the state is satisfied that the suspect is guilty of an offence with which he is changed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means courts that record its judicial acts and proceedings in writing or record book for permanent preservation and memorial."
Court of Record simply means courts that record its judicial acts and proceedings in writing or record book for permanent preservation and memorial.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the President of the Customary Court of Appeal and other Judges of the Customary Court of Appeal as may be prescribed by the House of Assembly or National Assembly in case of FCT."

The judicial head of the Court is the President of the Customary Court of Appeal and other Judges of the Customary Court of Appeal as may be prescribed by the House of Assembly or National Assembly in case of FCT.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a consideration of all the evidence adduced before it and proceeds to convict or to discharge and acquit the accused person."
The judgment is a consideration of all the evidence adduced before it and proceeds to convict or to discharge and acquit the accused person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Superior Court of Record with unlimited jurisdiction."
The High court is a Superior Court of Record with unlimited jurisdiction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as the Force Headquarters now situate at the Federal Capital Territory Abuja."
The office of the IGP is referred to as the Force Headquarters now situate at the Federal Capital Territory Abuja.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sole authority in Nigeria saddled with education of lawyers and maintains high standards in lawyers training in Nigeria."
The Council of Legal Education is the sole authority in Nigeria saddled with education of lawyers and maintains high standards in lawyers training in Nigeria.
fib: ______ is the paper detailing the offences committed by the accused person and is divided into counts.
charge
A charge is the paper detailing the offences committed by the accused person and is divided into counts.
______ refers to the whole body of lawyers who preside at the courts.
Judiciary
The Judiciary refers to the whole body of lawyers who preside at the courts.
______ is regarded as Customary Law, or rules stated in the Koran guiding devoted Muslims.
Islamic Law itself
Islamic Law itself is regarded as Customary Law, or rules stated in the Koran guiding devoted Muslims.
______ is the final court of Appeal in Nigeria and the decision of the court is final and is binding on all parties.
Supreme Court
The Supreme Court is the final court of Appeal in Nigeria and the decision of the court is final and is binding on all parties.
______ is called upon immediately to take his plea, unless he has any objection to the charge or service.
accused
The accused is called upon immediately to take his plea, unless he has any objection to the charge or service.
______ are the responsibility of the Local Government Council.
Area and Customary Courts
Area and Customary Courts are the responsibility of the Local Government Council.
According to the course material, how many types of courts that could be regarded in Nigeria as inferior courts are there? (answer in figures)
four

There are four types of courts that could be regarded in Nigeria as inferior courts, while two, though strictly could not be regarded as a court but play important role in the administration of Justice in Nigeria.
